text:
aya: quick note — bringing up sakura-next int8 profile on staging. smoke found two locale oddities we should triage.

zheng: what symptoms?

aya: (1) Japanese polite prompts lose keigo markers and rephrase to blunt versions. (2) mixed RTL/LTR lines (Arabic + English) sometimes flip bracket order and drop trailing punctuation.

marta: only on int8 path?

aya: yes, only seen with int8 + matmul-v3 + fused-softmax. fp32/q4 look fine.

leo: short repro numbers?

aya: tiny sample from onboard smoke:
```
fp32: BLEU=33.7, COMET=0.50
int8-v3: BLEU=28.2, COMET=0.19
delta: BLEU -5.5, COMET -0.31
```

aya: example ja input: "\u5148\u751f\u3055\u3093\u3001\u3054\u305f\u304f\u3057\u307e\u3059\u304b\u3002"
aya: fp32 -> "Would you please read this, Professor? (polite)"
aya: int8 -> "Will you read this, Professor?"  <-- politeness missing

zheng: raw token traces?

aya: token counts same but int8 sometimes inserts a 0 token around punctuation in mixed-dir lines. snippet:
```
fp32 ids: [6140, 7, 1843, 120]
int8 ids: [6140, 7, 0, 1843, 120]
```

marta: that 0 would break detok + bidi ordering — explains bracket flip. do we know if 0 comes from sampling or a buffer issue?

leo: hypotheses: quantized-softmax rounding, stray zeroed slot after matmul transpose, or postprocess trimming bug. we should run a high-precision trace.

aya: repro script: `./scripts/locale_repro.sh --model sakura-next --profile int8-v3 --cases ja-keigo,ar-bracket` — attached minimal run below.

```
[repro] model=sakura-next int8-v3
[repro] case=ar-bracket
[repro] generated_ids: ... 3321, 40, 0, 2219, ...
[repro] detok => ")API(" (expected "(API)")
```

ops-bot: staging snapshot applied: staging/int8-2789012345

zheng: immediate guard: add a detok sanitizer that collapses NUL/0 tokens and normalizes paired punctuation before bidi. low risk.

marta: also add two onboard smoke checks: ja-keigo-preserve and ar-bracket-preserve. block int8 merge if they fail.

leo: i'll run svmap+asan on matmul-v3 with mixed-dir prefixes to check pointer/stride misalignment. ETA ~3h.

aya: created ML ticket ML-2333 with failing inputs and repro commands (internal). linking traces here after leo's run.

marta: thanks — i'll land the detok guard PR and CI smoke additions now. we'll reconvene after kernel traces.

aya: ack, keeping thread live. :pray:
